delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile methodology characterized by short, time-boxed iterations that allow for regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative approach ensures that the solution evolves in alignment with client expectations and accommodates changes in scope through controlled processes.

AI tools will assist in drafting documentation, generating code snippets, and automating routine tasks, while human experts will review, integrate, and approve all outputs to maintain quality and relevance. This collaboration between AI and people enhances productivity and accuracy throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring a high-quality deliverable that meets the client’s needs.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to enhance its human resource management through a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) that streamlines employee data management, leave and attendance tracking, and reporting. This initiative is critical to improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and employee self-service capabilities, ultimately supporting better decision-making and workforce management.

Exist Software Labs proposes to deliver a cloud-deployed, microservices-based HRIS solution tailored to Kalinaw Trading Corporation's needs. The system will be developed using a modern technology stack including Java, Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL, ensuring scalability and security. The project will follow a structured delivery schedule culminating in a fully operational system that meets the agreed requirements.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution integrates key capabilities such as employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and comprehensive reporting. It supports various user roles including employees, HR staff, approvers, and management, facilitating workflows like leave applications, approvals, document management, and certificate generation. The system aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's operational processes by enabling data migration from existing records and providing real-time notifications and audit trails to ensure transparency and compliance.

This solution enhances the client’s way of working by automating routine HR tasks, improving data accessibility through self-service portals, and supporting decision-making with management dashboards and standard reports. The approach emphasizes usability, security, and performance to meet the client’s requirements for concurrent users and availability, thereby delivering tangible benefits in efficiency and employee engagement.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is architected as a cloud-hosted microservices platform leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend user interface, and PostgreSQL as the primary data store. The system is designed with layered application components including user interface, business logic, data access, and integration services. It supports secure role-based access control and maintains comprehensive audit trails for all critical operations.

Integration with external payroll systems is handled through defined interfaces ensuring reliable data exchange and reconciliation. The cloud deployment includes separate environments for development, testing, and production, enabling scalable performance to support up to 300 concurrent users with high availability targets. Security measures and data protection are integral to the design, aligning with the client’s non-functional requirements.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected by Exist Software Labs. Defects can be reported through established channels, and the warranty covers all functionality as specified in the project scope.

Issues arising from misuse, unauthorized modifications, or external factors are excluded from the warranty. Additional support and maintenance services beyond the warranty period are available as separate options, providing ongoing assistance to ensure the system’s continued performance and reliability.
